item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will bring persistently very hot and fine weather to southern China during the weekend and next week.

Date/Month: 23/07 (Saturday)
Wind: Southwest force 2 to 3.
Weather: Fine and very hot.
Temp range: 28 - 35 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
